messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice perturbation search optimizing exact triple-area minimums

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration is a perturbed lattice based on 13 points of the (3,4,5)-rational lattice scaled to fit the unit square, with the minimal-area triangle being a perturbation of a three-collinear-point configuration rather than a small generic triangle. Specifically, starting from a 4×4 grid with three corner-adjacent collinear triples, perturbing the two interior collinear points in each triple by approximately ±0.018 perpendicular to the collinear direction yields a minimum triangle area of approximately 0.0092, exceeding any unperturbed lattice configuration. The conjectured optimal minimum area is exactly 1/108 ≈ 0.00926, achieved when all three collinear-triple perturbations are balanced so that no smaller generic triangle drops below this threshold."}
